title: AI ‘slop’ is a social judgement
title_zh: AI‘垃圾信息’是一种社会判断
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI)-generated content increasingly saturates our information environment. Efforts to detect and remove it are failing. We propose that calling AI-generated content ‘slop’ is best understood as a social judgement: what a community recognizes as unwanted AI content. Studying AI slop this way makes it tractable, measurable and governable.
abstract_zh: 人工智能（AI）生成的内容正日益饱和我们的信息环境。旁检和删除的努力正在失败。我们提议，将AI生成的内容称为‘垃圾信息’，最好被理解为一种社会判断：社区将其识别为不想要的AI内容。以这种方式研究AI‘垃圾信息’使其变得可操作、可测量且可治理。
